description: How someone is getting on with an AdventureLive trip (a trek, a high mountain, an ocean row, an expedition, a tour operator's departure), tracked from a Garmin inReach, a SPOT, Garmin LiveTrack or a phone. Use it for "how is Sam doing on Kilimanjaro?", a livedot.me/<name>/<code> trip link, or an operator's departures. Inputs: trip as the user gave it: the link, their livedot handle (@sam, livedot.me/sam), or the trip's or the person's name. Returns the weather where they are first (its safety alerts and the readings that matter for that kind of trip), then the leg they are on, when their tracker last sent and how, with the live map. A position only while they are moving and the trip is one anyone may follow; a Link only trip only by its link; People I approve: only its name. A satellite tracker sends every 10 minutes to a few hours, so "last seen 40 min ago" is normal. Taps on the back on a trip are only counted, never sent to their tracker.

code.description: The trip's code, when you already have it (from a link or an earlier answer).

trip.description: The trip link (livedot.me/<handle>/<code>), their livedot handle (@name or livedot.me/name), or the trip's or person's name as the user said it.

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: trip_status

outputSchema.description: An AdventureLive trip, as anyone with its link may see it: the weather where they are first, then where and when they were last seen.

activity.description: The kind of trip (trek, mountain, ocean-row…).

basis.description: forecast when the weather is a forecast.

cause.description: What it is for, when they added one: { name, url }.

conditions.description: The weather at the dot, first: alerts ({ level, words, sub }), lead ({ name, big, small }), credits ({ text, url }), at (ISO).

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong.

leg.description: { no, of, label, routed }: the leg they are on.

locked.description: People I approve: { name, who }: only the people they approve can follow it.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user.

name.description: Their name as the trip page shows it.

position.description: Only while they are moving and the trip page shows a position: { km, of_km } along a leg with a route (null on a leg with none), seen (ISO).

signup.description: Without a sign-in: a free account link, when the server adds one.

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

status.description: live, nosignal, paused, waiting or finished.

taps.description: { count, count_only: true, note }: taps on a trip are only counted, never sent to the tracker.

trips.description: Several (view "trips"): name, who, url (livedot.me), live, status, start, activity. Ask which one.

via.description: What sent it: Garmin inReach, SPOT, Garmin LiveTrack, their phone.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Follow an adventure trip
